x: Krishnapatnam (SPSR Nellore, PPP-BOST) has 11 berths and 98 MMT capacity. A (4 MMT, State-run) is Kakinada Anchorage, B (64 MMT, deepest draft) is Gangavaram, and D (16 MTPA, DBFOT) is Kakinada Gateway.

Rawa (Ravva) is Cairn India's Single Buoy Mooring for crude oil. The others are mismatched: Kakinada Gateway is GMR with 16 MTPA, Machilipatnam is MEIL with 35 MTPA, and RPDCL/34.04 MTPA belong to Ramayapatnam (Mulapeta is Vishwa Samudra, 23.5 MTPA).

Under the India-UK CETA the UK opens 137 service sub-sectors. Entry into force on 1 June 2026 is the India-Oman CEPA (CETA came into force on 15 July 2026); the US$100 bn investment over 15 years is the India-EFTA TEPA; 97% of tariff lines and 99.5% of trade value is the India-EU FTA.

USMCA (USA, Mexico, Canada) replaced NAFTA. ASEAN states plus China and Japan describes RCEP, not SAFTA; Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay are Mercosur, not BIMSTEC; India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka are SAFTA/SAARC members, not Mercosur.

Visakhapatnam is the deepest landlocked, protected port and is called the 'Brightest Jewel'. Vembanad Lake belongs to Kochi and 'oldest major port' to Kolkata-Haldia; the only riverine port on the Hooghly is Kolkata-Haldia; the tidal port with Asia's first EPZ is Deendayal (Kandla).
In EPI 2024 (4th edition, released by NITI Aayog in Jan 2026) Andhra Pradesh ranked 5th among large States, after Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh. Ninth was AP's rank in EPI 2021.
Andhra Pradesh ranked 9th in EPI 2021, the second edition (APPSC-GS 2022 key). In EPI 2024 (4th edition) it ranked 5th among large States.

The EPI pillars are Business Ecosystem (40% in EPI 2024), Export Infrastructure, Policy and Governance, and Export Performance (20% each). Business environment, export policy and export infrastructure correspond to these; agricultural land ownership is not a pillar.

Kakinada SEZ is a port-based multi-product SEZ with the GMR Kakinada Gateway Port. Divi's pharma belongs to the Visakhapatnam/Parawada region, Foxconn's electronics cluster to Sri City, and the Atchutapuram apparel city is Brandix.

Vizag (Parawada Pharma City) is identified with pharmaceutical exports. Turmeric is linked to Guntur, mango pulp is a separate AP export item, and tobacco is AP's top export by share but is not tied to Vizag.
